items.summary: Investors weighed new trade measures against Canada and Iran, looming Nvidia earnings, and predictions for Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech as Fed chair.

items.title: Nvidia earnings in focus: Why its networking segment is growing faster than compute
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is reporting second quarter earnings on Wednesday after the closing bell. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at Nvidia's data center business in this Chart of the Day.

items.title: The real question investors should be asking ahead of Nvidia earnings
items.summary: D.A. Davidson Head of Technology Research Gil Luria talks with Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma about how traders should approach Nvidia (NVDA) ahead of its latest earnings report after enduring its longest losing streak since 2022.

items.title: Nvidia stock hopes to snap seven-day losing streak ahead of earnings
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is due to report its second quarter earnings after the closing bell on Wednesday, August 26. The AI chipmaker's stock has been on a seven-day losing streak, leaving investors to wonder which direction these results could push the stock. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre and StockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip examine how Nvidia shares are performing compared to the broader semiconductor space.

items.title: What's at stake for Paramount, the Ellisons in Warner Bros. takeover bid
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is facing some pushback from a collection of US attorneys general in its proposed acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Evan Shapiro — better known as "The Media Cartographer" — comes on Market Domination Overtime to outline what is it at stake for the media giant and the Ellison family if the deal ultimately falls through.

items.title: Tesla to launch Cybercabs in Austin starting Sept. 3
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian reports on Tesla (TSLA) launching Cybercabs starting on Sept. 3 in Austin. The company expects to roll out 2,500 robotaxis in 2026.
